source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: For the Indomitor Kill Team, add 1 Strength when shooting the closest eligible enemy. In melee, add 1 Strength as well during a turn in which the team completed a **Charge move**.
